name: pro4tech-api
description: Scripts da raiz para rodar backend e frontend juntos, sem Docker (Windows e Linux).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.docker:up:ai:gpu: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu.yml --profile ai up -d --build
